༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu las gnad don rags pa bsdus pa'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /dpal ldan

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu las gnad don rags pa bsdus pa'o// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /dpal ldan khro chen rgyal po la btud nas/ /dpal ldan bya phyir gnad don ri mor bri/ /de la 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ gang gi gtan la 'bebs par byed pa spyi don dang / gang gtan la dbab par byed pa yan lag gi don no/ /dang po ni/ brtson 'grus can tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byed pa rdo rje theg pa ni/ phar phyin las khyad par 'phags chos ni/ grub chen ḍoṃ bhi he ru kas/ 'dir ni snod kyi khyad par dang / /snod du byed pa'i chos dang ni/ /'bras bu dag gis khyad par gyis/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa la/ theg pa 'og ma gsum gyi rnam par 'jog tshul dang / rdo rje theg pa'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnas skabs theg pa gsum du bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan/ theg pa gsum po de 'og ma las gong ma gong ma khyad par 'phags par bstan pa'i sgo nas khyad par 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dbang po rno rtul gyi bye brag gi rigs can gsum du dbye'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs dpyad pa'i sgo nas/ theg dman gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus te bshad pa/ theg chen nyan rang las khyad par 'phags chos ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams kyis sogs kyi nyan rang gi mngon rtogs phyogs gcig tu gsungs pas 'dir yang de gnyis kyi theg pa phyogs gcig dpyad na/ 'phags pas/ nyan thos theg pa 'di la ni sogs kyis nyan rang la byang chub sems dpa'i bsngo smon sogs kun rdzob byang sems rlabs po che ma bstan pa dang / lta ba yang / bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs pa grub mtha' smra ba bzhi ka mthun/ chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par 'dod pa dang /

rtogs par 'dod pa'i phyogs gnyis su grags pa la/ byams mgon rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ma rtogs par bzhed de/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang sogs kyis dngos po la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sgo nas/ gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi thabs mkhas bral nas rgyal yum la ring ba dang / rgyal yum ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /sogs kyis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pa la bshad pa'i phyir dang / sbyor lam gyi skabs su/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang sogs kyis theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi po/ nyan rang las dmigs rnam khyad par 'phags tshul dang / de bzhin sgom lam sogs dbye ba rgyas par gsungs so/ /gang gi dngos gcig sogs kyis dngos po gcig chos kyi bdag med du mthong na dngos po kun gyi chos nyid bdag med du mthong ba bstan te/ chos dbyings la yod med dang mang nyung med pa'o/ /'di dag gi skabs su rtags bsal khyab gsum la rigs pa nges dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni slob dpon zla grags rjes 'brang dang bcas pa 'ga' zhig gis lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed du ma bkod nas/ nyan rang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bshad/ lung ni sa bcu par kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste dper na rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i rgyal po'i bu sogs dang / sdud par/ gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam sogs dang / nyan thos la gdams pa'i mdor/ gzugs ni dbu ma rdos pa 'dra sogs dang / rin chen phreng bar/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa sogs dang / /gnyis pa rigs pa ni 'jug par/ khyod kyi rnal 'byor bdag med mthong ba yi sogs dang / 'jug 'grel las/ gzugs la sogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo la dmigs pas so/ /de'i rjes su 'brang nas bod la la'i zer tshul dpyad pa mang ngo / /'phags pa'i dngos slob legs ldan 'byed kyis nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa rgyas pa med par gsungs pa ni sangs rgyas dang klu sgrub yab sras kyi bzhed pa'o/

/theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed ma bsgom na stong nyid rtogs par mi srid de/ sdud par/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba sogs/ slob dpon zla bas drangs pa'i sa bcu pa'i lung gi rgyal ba'i sras sogs kyi don ni/ sems bskyed ma thag pa zhes 'byung bas/ byang sems las dang po pas sems bskyed kyi lhag bsam gyis nyan rang rnams zil gyis gnon kyang / gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i cha nas gnon mi nus pa la dgongs pa yin te byang sems las dang po pas/ bdag med thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa tsam las med la nyan rang dgra bcom pas ni mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /nyan thos la gdams pa'i mdo yi dgongs pa ni/ 'char byed la gdams pa'i mdo las/ bdag ni sems can so so'i lus 'di la/ /nga dang bdag tu bzung nas chags gyur te/ /bdag ni na dang shi bkres grang gis dogs/ /bstod na dga' zhing smad na mi dga' ste/ /de lta dmigs nas mu stegs lta rnams 'jug /nga'am bdag de yod pa ma yin te/ /phung po 'di la brten nas 'khrul pa yin/ /zhes so/ /kha cig nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod de 'khor ba las thar ba'i phyir zer mod/ mi rigs te/ bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug bsgom pas 'khor ba las thar ba bsnyon med par gsungs te/ bshes spring las/ thar pa bdag la rag las sogs/ /gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas nyan rang la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom pa med tshul mang du gsungs so/ /lang kar gshegs par/ blo gros chen po/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ni/ chos la bdag med mthong ba'i bye brag gis rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/ gang zag bdag med par mthong ba'i bye brag gi rnam par dag par 'gyur ro sogs/ rje rtse mos saṃ bu ṭi'i 'grel par/ gnyis med gnyis kyi rnam spangs zhes pa'i skabs dang / spyod 'jug gi 'grel par/ sems ni dmigs dang bcas sogs kyi skabs dang /

rje btsun chen pos kyang de ltar bzhed la/ rje sa paṇa gyi thub pa dgongs gsal las gang zag gi bdag med ma rtogs na phyi rol pa'i sgom dang khyad par med/ chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs na nyan thos kyi sgom dang khyad par med/ ces nyan thos kyi chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs par gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /rab dbyer stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang bsgom zhes pa'i don/ gang zag rang dbang can gyi rdzas yod kyis stong pa'i stong nyid de'o/ /rnam 'grel gyi stong nyid lta bas sogs kyang de'o/ /nyan thos kyi bsngo ba sangs rgyas su bsngo ba yod kyang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems dang bral bas sangs rgyas mi nus/ /'dul lung theg chen dang thun mong ba'i rgyu mtshan/ theg pa gnyis ka'i lta sgom spyod 'bras bstan no/ /theg dman ni gsal la theg chen ni stong pa nyid dang skye med sogs dang / bdag gi bram ze 'dod pa sogs dang / gzhan yang theg chen gyi khyad par mang du gsungs mod/ bdag gzhan brje ba ma gsungs so/ /yang rab dbyer/ nyan thos dang ni theg chen la/ /lta ba'i rim pa yod mod kyi sogs la gzigs/ spyi don gnyis pa byang sems kyi theg pa/ nyan rang gi theg pa las khyad par 'phags chos ngos bzung ba ni/ chen po bdun gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / sa lam gyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa ste rgyas par rgyud sde spyi rnam sogs na gsal lo// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa gang khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ gang gi gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i spyi don dang / gang gtan la dbab par bya ba yan lag gi don no/ /dang po la gsum/ rdo rje theg pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ngos bzung ba/ ngos zin pa'i rnam grangs kyi ming don bshad pa/ don dang ldan pa'i rdo rje theg pa de phar phyin las khyad par 'phags par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni rdo rje'i theg pa dang /

'bras bu'i theg pa dang / thabs kyi theg pa'o/ /gnyis pa ming don ni sngags zhes pa sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te de ni mtshan rtog las skyob pas so/ /de'ang stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pa'o/ /skyon 'joms pa'i ldog pa nas rig sngags/ yon tan 'dzin pa'i ldog pa nas rig sngags so/ /gsum pa don dang ldan pa'i theg pa de phar phyin theg pa las khyad par 'phags par bshad pa la gnyis/ khyad par 'phags chos ngos bzung nas theg pa de gnyis kyi khyad par 'byed chos kyi ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang / de nyid don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de gnyis kyi khyad par tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas byed nus mi nus so/ /gnyis pa de nyid kyi don rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ bya rgyud de las khyad par du 'phags par byed pa'i 'phags chos ngos bzung ba/ spyod rgyud de las khyad par du 'phags par byed pa'i 'phags chos ngos bzung ba/ rnal 'byor rgyud de las khyad par du 'phags par byed pa'i 'phags chos ngos bzung ba/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi zab khyad bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dgag bzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni bya rgyud rang rkang la bdag bskyed yod zer ba de'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bya rgyud phar phyin theg pa las khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa dngos dang / bye brag tu bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod med kyi mtha' dpyad pa/ de la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ khyad par 'phags tshul mdor bstan/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ phyugs kyi shing rta dang nyi zla'i 'gros dper mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'di rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig ma tshang na'ang skye ba gsum nas 'grub par bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ smin grol te spyod pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bya rgyud bdag bskyed yod med kyi mtha' dpyad pa la bzhi/ bya rgyud la bla med kyi bskyed chog sbyar tshul bshad pa/

spyod rgyud kyi༞ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi༞ bya rgyud rang lugs so/ /gsum pa rtsod spong ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par bya rgyud la bdag bskyed bshad zer na/ de ni bya rgyud spyod rgyud du bkral ba'o/ /gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi zab khyad ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ phar phyin las zab tshul/ bya rgyud spyod rgyud khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa'i sgo nas spyod rgyud kyi zab khyad rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni tshe 'dir 'grub pa'o/ /de'ang spyod pa gsum ste bya rgyud bzhin la nang gses cung zad yod do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ bya rgyud las lam gang gis khyad par 'phags tshul/ khyad par 'phags pa'i spyod rgyud kyi sgra don no/ /dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgom pa sogs spyod pa gsum gyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams so/ /rang nyid lhar bsgom pa ni 'dir brtul zhugs mchog tu gsungs te/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ zhi ba'i blo gros gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa 'di nyid/ rang gi lha'i gzugs byas la the tshom med pa'i yid kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal bskyed cing / 'gro yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / nyal yang rung / rtag tu dus thams cad du sogs gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam spyod pa sogs kyis so/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi zab khyad ngos bzung ba la gnyis/ zab tshul mdor bstan pa dang / de nyid rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ tshe 'dir 'grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa la smin grol te rgyas par yo ga'i gzhung chen rnams su blta/ 'dir stong nyid bsgom pa la phyag rgya 'ching zhes pa/ phyag chen thig ler/ phyag ni stong pa zhes bya ste/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i rgya las grol/ /zhes so// ༈ /bzhi pa bla med kyi zab khyad bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ bla med kyi tshul mdor bstan pa dang /

zab khyad kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ brtson 'grus can dbang po rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas par bstan pa dang / 'bring bar dor sangs rgyas par bstan pa dang / tha ma skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /'di dag ni gsang 'dus sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde dgongs 'grel dang bcas par gsal lo/ /gnyis pa zab khyad kyi chos rnams rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ rjod byed sgra'i zab khyad/ brjod bya'i don gyi zab khyad do/ /dang po ni/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi sogs kyis so/ 'di dag rgyud sde 'og mar med do/ /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi zab khyad ni/ smin grol 'bras bu'i zab khyad gsum mo/ /dang po la gang khyad par du 'phags pa'i rab dbye/ dpon slob kyi mtshan nyid/ dbang gi dgos pa/ mi nyams par byed pa dam tshig dang lnga'o/ /de dag gzhan du blta/ lus 'di nam grub pa na/ de la ming 'dogs pa 'brel ba can du 'byung bas rnam snang la ming dbang du bzhag dkyil chog nyi shu par rnam snang la chu dbang dang / mi bskyod pa la ming bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rig pa'i dbang la zab tshul/ lha yab yum sogs khro chags kyi rnam pa can dang / dbang rdzas bdud rtsi lnga sogs/ bskur yul rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed pa dang / dgos pa dbang lha rigs lnga chags can rnams pas/ bskur yul slob ma rigs lnga zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bskyed pa la/ dbang rdzas bdud rtsi lnga'i khu bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rtsa khams thams cad byin gyis brlabs nas/ yas nas byon pa'i bdud rtsis rkyen byas te/ gzhir gnas kyi byang sems 'phel ba dang rgyas par byas nas/ lus kyi cha shas rnams rim pa bzhin du gang bas/ dga' ba dang po gsum rim pa bzhin skye zhing mthar lus kyi cha shas rtsa 'khor bzhi la sogs pa rtsa gnas mtha' dag byang chub sems kyis gang ba las lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ba yin pas dga' ba bzhi bskyed pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can bum dbang gi dus nas 'grig pa cig dgos pa yin/

rnal 'byor rgyud du ni de 'dra ba'i bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang po tha ma la dbang bzhi cig car ro/ /dbang gong ma'i skabs su gsang rdzas dngos su ster ba dang / las rgya sprod pa ni khyim pa rdor 'dzin la dgongs/ rab tu byung bas ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas so/ /gang ltar dngos dbang bskur na slob mas kyang bskyed rim brtan la gsang ba'i lam bsgoms pas 'pho med kyi tshul khrims thob pa gcig nges par dgos/ ga bur 'dzag na dga' bzhi rgyud la mi skye'o/ /gsum pa'i ye shes de dpe yi ye shes yin gyi don gyi ye shes min te/ gal te yin na mthong lam thob par thal/ phar phyin gyi mthong lam dang sngags mi gcig zer ba kha sbyor las/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sogs lung rigs dang 'gal lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su lha sku yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa bsgom pa yod la/ de nyid kyi rgyun bsgom pa'i stobs kyis zhi ba'i dus su rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal lha'i skur gnas gyur te/ rang dang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gsal la ma 'gags pa mngon du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku sogs sku bzhir ngo sprad/ snang ba dang bral ba'i stong rkyang min no/ /brtag gnyis su ye shes 'di ni zhes pa'i don dbang gsum pa'i dus su skyes pa'i ye shes la gsal bar bshad do/ /yang slob dpon mang pos dbang bzhi pa'i don stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba la ngo sprad pa'i dgos pa yang dbang gsum pa'i dus su skyes pa'i lha sku'i snang ba mi 'dor ba'i ngang nas phyag rgya la brten nas dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa de la stong pa nyid kyi rgyas btab nas bsgom pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /tshig gi bzhi pa zhes pa snod rung du bya ste/ don spyi go ba la thob pa'i tha snyad byed do/ /don gyi bzhi pa'i skabs rten can rten med ni/ gsum pa'i dus su ye shes ngos ma zin na slar yang las kyi phyag rgya ster ba rten can no/

/gsum pa'i myong ba la ngo sprod pa tsam ni rten med do/ /don gyi bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa mthong lam mo/ /'bras bu'i bzhi pa ni yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang la byed do/ /slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyi skabs su thams cad tshang ba ma rnyed kyang don dam bsnyen par gsungs pa ltar yon tan shas che tsam dang / khyad par rtsa ltung med pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi kun spyod mtha' dag gsang sngags 'gal zlar smra zhing bag yangs su spyod pa ni shin tu nor tshab che'o/ /kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dzñā na shrīs mig phug pa bzhin du bkag ste/ ji skad du/ tshul khrims dang / dam tshig dang / sdom pa mi 'gal ba las/ dang por rab tu byung ba stan sogs/ mdor na gsang sngags kyi rten la khyim pa las rab byung mchog tu gsungs pa 'di gzigs/ bla ma bsten tshul gyi skabs su/ lnga bcu par/ khyim pa'am ni gsar bu la/ /brtul zhugs ldan pa sogs kyi don dang po bla mar byed mi byed brtags skabs yin gyi/ bla mar byas phyin khyim pa dang / bslab pa rang las gzhon yang phyag dang bsnyen bkur ma byas na rtsa ltung ngo / /ye shes kyi dam tshig ni slob dpon dang sems can no/ /yon tan la khyad zhugs na khyim pa dang gzhon pa la phyag dang bsnyen bkur byed pa theg pa gsum char mthun no/ /yon tan gtso yi rtags tsam mi gtso'o/ /bla ma smod pa'i tshig la yang rna ba mi gtad sogs la bslab bo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgom skabs kyi dogs spong la so skye'i slob dpon yin yang sangs rgyas su nges par bsgom dgos te dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyis grub/ kha cig yul gyi gnas tshul dang blo yi 'dzin stangs 'gal snyam na sems bskyed la yang mtshungs pa sogs skyon mang ngo / /ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la zhal phyag rdzogs pa nges par dgos so/ /gzhan dbang bskur tshe thog mar bdag 'jug dgos par/ ko sa la'i rgyan las/ slob ma bzhugs pa'i dus la bab pa dang /

slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga dang por bya dgos te/ gang phyir gang la bdag brjod nges pa dang / dam tshig dang 'das pa 'ga' zhig byung ba dag srid pas na de'i phyir slob dpon nyid dang por 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng bar rang nyid dam tshig nyams na 'di lta bu'i dbang nyid ji ltar slob dpon gyi 'jug pa'i cho gar bshad pa de ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang bla ma dam pa shin tu ring ba dang bgrod dka' ba la sogs pa'i nye bar 'tshe bas bgrod par mi nus pa'i phyogs su gnas na ste gzhan du ma yin no/ /zhes sngags kyi rtsa ltung byung ba dag pa dang sngags sdom sor chud par bya ba'i phyir/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung skabs/ rnam snang gi dam tshig skyabs 'gro sogs bcu bzhi yod do/ /'o na rgyud sde gong ma gnyis kar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sngon du 'gro bar mtshungs na/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag gi ltung ba brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis bla med kyi bsrung bya'i sdom par bshad nas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bslab bya'i dam tshig tu ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi rgyud sde bzhi ka'i sdom pa de dag bzung ba'i cho gas theg pa ma yin gyi de dag rang rang gi dbang bskur gyi stobs kyis thob pa yin te/ rab dbyer rigs 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yang / /dbang bskur med na thob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na rgyud sde gong ma gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa yang rang rang gi dbang bskur gyis thob pa yin pas bsrung bya'i ltung ba yang so sor yin no/ /'dir ni rigs 'dzin zhes pa ni/ rje sa chen gyi gsung sgros gnyag gis bris par/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dus su me tog gang la phog pa'i lha dang de'i sngags yin/ de 'dzin pa ni bsgom bzlas kyi sgo nas de mnyes par byed pa la gsungs so/ /sngags sdom ngos bzung ba ni/

snang grags rig gsum gyi chos thams cad lha sngags ye shes su blta ba'i sems dpa' rgyun chags gcig la/ sngags kyi sdom pa zhes kyang bya/ dam tshig ces kyang bya ste/ zhes rje btsun sku mched kyis gsung ngo / /rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis la snang ba lhar bsgom pa ni med la/ rnal 'byor rgyud du rang lhar bsgom pa yod de/ dpal mchog las/ rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /zhes gsungs la/ de'i 'grel par/ grub chen kun snying gis/ rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung zhes pa ni rang nyid lhag pa'i lha rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang ldan pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyod rgyud du'ang rang lhar bsgom pa sngags sdom yin te/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i lung gis so/ /bya rgyud la rang gi snying khar sngags phreng bkod pa sogs te lha sngags dbyer med du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa thogs med kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smon lam gyi mchog ni sems bskyed pa'o/ /'di 'phros don no/ /gnas 'gyur rgyu'i gnas ni rang don yid byed kyi blo de nyid yin la/ de gyur pa ni blo spang ba la bshad de shānti pas/ gnas ni sgrib pa la'o/ /gyur ba ni spang ba la'o/ /zhes so/ /mdor na sdom pa 'og ma gong mar gnas gyur nas gong ma gong mar 'pho ba'i tshul 'di rigs pas shes par bya'o/ /sngags su tha mal snang zhen de lha sngags su 'gyur ro/ /thams cad du spong sems ni dor ba ma yin no/ /rgyud 'bum pa'i lung don sdom gsum gnas 'gyur ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa 'di/ kha che dzñā na shrīs kyang mi 'gal bar bstan par bshad do/ /drin lan gsab par yang mthun dpe gsal lo/ /gnas 'gyur mi 'thad na kha sbyor sogs las ma dag pa'i sems can gyi rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bzhir gyur par bshad pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur/ gnas gyur la ma ltos pa'i sdom gsum ngo bo gcig pa ni/

theg pa 'og ma gnyis la ma zhugs par dbang bskur gcig pus thob pa de'o/ /dam tshig nyams na slar gso rung bar bstan pa ni/ 'o na gong du de ltar bshad pa'i sdom pa de nyid nyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i so thar dang 'dra bar sdom pa de lan cig nyams na slar gso mi rung ba zhig yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ ji ltar bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /gal te nyams par gang gyur pa/ /de ni rang gi snying po'i sngags/ /chig 'bum du ni bzlas brjod bya/ /yang na ma rmongs bye ba'i gzugs/ /stong du brjod pa byas kyang rung / /yang na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /yang na dkyil 'khor du ni gzhug /ces gsungs pas/ sems g.yeng ma g.yeng dang / ltung ba lci yang gi khyad par gyi bsnyen pa dang / zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang dbang blang ba'i sgo nas gso rung bar bshad do/ /de bzhin du rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis ka las bshad cing gong ma la gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud dang / dus 'khor gyi le'u gsum pa'i rtsa 'grel rnams las rtsa ltung byung na slar yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang blangs par bshad la/ lung ni gong du drug pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /rtsa ltung byung na gso tshul yang / a bha bas rang nyid kyi bla ma bsgrod par 'os pa'i gnas su bzhugs pa na bla ma las dbang blang la bsgrod par dka' ba'i gnas su bzhugs na rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang blangs kyang sor chud par bshad pa ltar slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis bshad de/ ko sa la yi rgyan gyi lung gong du drangs pa ltar ro// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa grol byed lam gyi zab khyad la bzhi/ bsgom bya'i lam la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod dgos par bstan nas/ de la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul gyi rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rim gnyis nyams su len tshul bshad pa/ nyams su blang ba la brten nas drod sogs kyi yon tan skye tshul bshad pa'o/

/dang po ni slob dpon shrardha kar warmas/ rgyan bdun grol ba las/ rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud 'dzin pas/ /'bras bu rgyud la rag las te/ /sa bon lta bu'i gang zag lnga/ /spang blang bye brag shes par bya/ /de nas rim par dbang blangs te/ /thabs kyi rgyud la 'jug par bya/ /dang por nyan pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig gi rgyud la thos pa bskyed/ /de nas bsam pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig dang don de 'brel bar bslab/ /de nas bsgom pa'i blo rtsal gyis/ /dang po bskyed pa'i rim la bslab/ /de nas rdzogs pa mthar dbyung ste/ /kha bub rdol dang dug can gyis/ /skyon rnams spangs te rgud gnas na/ /chu lud rkyen gyis 'bras bskyed bzhin/ /zhes lam bsgom pa'i gong du nyams su blang bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod dgos par bshad cing / grub chen mi thub zla bas ku mu ti'i phreng ba las/ slob dpon med la thos pa med/ /ma thos pa la bsam pa med/ /gnyis bral rnal 'byor lam med cing / /rnal 'byor bral la dngos grub med/ /ces sogs mtha' yas so/ /des na thog mar phar phyin nas brtsams te rim gyis bslab ste/ de ltar ma bslabs na phar phyin gsang sngags kyi 'gal zlar smra ba dang / bla med kyi zab khyad mi shes pa dang / the tshom gyis gegs byed pa sogs mang du yod pas/ thog mar thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa/ sgro 'dogs gcod tshul gyi rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa la lnga/ rim gnyis kyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ nges tshig grangs nges/ so so'i bsgom tshul lo/ /spyod bsdus kyi gang zhig skye ba sogs kyi don/ sems can gyi skye 'chi gnyis po de/ sbyang gzhi'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis su bla ma'i drin gyis ngo sprod pa las rnyed pa de ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs khyad par can du bsngags pa yin no/ /kha cig bskyed rim rnam rtog yin pas rdzogs rim stong nyid kho na bsgom zer ba gnad ma go bar chos rang rang gi che brjod sogs kyi lung don ma go ba ste bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka nges par dgos pa sogs thabs shes ya ma bral ba thams cad du gal che'o/

/kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i chos thams cad sgyu ma dang 'dra bar lta ba dang ma bral/ nyon mongs pa tshegs med par spong ba dang / dge ba la rlom sems la sogs pa 'dor ba la sogs nas/ dngos por 'dzin pa las grol zhing sgyu ma dang 'dra bar rang bzhin gcig pa las mi phyed pas 'di ni rdo rje theg pa zhes bya la/ ye shes zhabs kyis dgongs pa tha mal rnam rtog sogs kyi don bskyed rim dang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gnyis 'gal bar gsal bar gsungs la/ 'gal lugs ni rnam pa 'gal ba ste/ zab gsal gnyis med do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched sogs dang mi 'dra ste de ni bdag med par mi 'jug go /mdor na dmigs pa lha la dmigs nas rnam pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la zhugs pa'i blos gzugs rnams rten dang brten par shar ba'o/ /gnad 'di ma shes na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du gsungs pa'i bram ze'i khye'u rtsa nag skya bzhin no/ /rdzogs rim gyi skabs bskyed pa'i snang phyogs thams cad lha'i 'khor lor bsgom pa la stong nyid kyi rgyas btab nas lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du bsgom pa yod kyang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa ltar gyi rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i stobs kyis skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa lha'i gsungs la gzigs/ sbyang gzhi'i skabs su/ 'o na sems rang nyid gang la skye zhe na/ stong pa gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi skye ba yin/ saṃ ṭir chos kyi phung po brgyad khri sogs kyi don lus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa med pas rgyud sde 'og mas kyang bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa mi 'grub par bstan/ 'chi ba'i dus rlung nam mkha' la thim/ sbyang gzhi lus la gnad du bsnun pa ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis char yin la/ de'ang phyi bskyed rim gyis brgyud nas so/ /nang bskyed rim gyis dngos su bsnun/

'khor lo drug gi rtsa thig lhar bsgom pa rdo rje snying rje pa dang / gnyug ma drag gsal du 'khor lo lnga la bsnun par bshad/ birwa pa'i man ngag phyag rgya bzhi pa'o/ /bzhi pa rba rlabs/ mas brtan dwangs ma gser 'gyur rtsi lta bus/ /lcags 'dra'i rnal 'byor lus la reg pa yis/ /pra sen dbab bzhin 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gyur/ /zhar byung rang nyid bsgom pa'i lha de yin min la/ /rang lugs rje btsun gong mas yin pas bsgom par bzhed/ /rtsod pa kha cig na re/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo bde mchog tu grub na/ bde mchog rang gi lus dkyil 'khor grub pa mi shes pa 'gal zer ba sogs so/ /lan/ kyai rdor sogs la gzhi lam 'bras gsum du byas gzhi yin par bshad kyi/ spangs rtogs kun rdzogs su khas blang rgyu ni da lta dngos su med kyang rkyen dang 'phrad na 'bras bu skye rung du rje rtse mos bshad/ rgyu rgyud thabs shes gnyis med ni/ dngos po gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa sna tshogs su snang ba thabs te 'khor ba dang / de nyid kyi tshe ngo bo spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bas mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /de gnyis dbyer med pa ni rgyu'i rgyud do/ /rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi lus la bsnun pa bla med kyi dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam mo/ /rim gnyis bsgom pa las byung ba'i drod ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus mthu khyad par can no/ /rtags ni du sogs pa'i skabs rim lngar snang ba gsum po mthong ma thag sa bcu la ni rab tu gnas/ /'dir bskyed rim gyis sa brgyad dang dben gsum mthar phyin pas sa bcur bshad/ sa lam gyi dbye bsdu/ phar phyin theg pa rang lam gyi sa bcu pa zin tsam nas bzung ste bla med nas bshad pa'i rgyu lus kyi rtogs pa ma thob kyi bar du rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang / bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa mtha' dag sa bcu'i nang du bsdus nas/ sa'i grangs bcur byas nas/ de'i steng du dpe med sogs grangs bla med la grags pa'i sa bcu gsum gyi rnam gzhag byed do/

/lung grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag 'grel par sa'i rgyu snying kha'i nang bskor laṃ maṃ sogs/ snying kha'i nang du bhrūṃ aṃ sogs/ 'o na sbas pa'i rtsa lnga po de gang yin snyam na/ dbu ma dang ro rkyang gnyis la/ gnyis gnyis su gyes pa'i lnga po yin par slob dpon rin po ches gsungs so/ /kun gzhi gnas 'gyur sogs kyi don/ 'gyur zhes bya ba ni/ rang rang gi ngo bo de rnams ldog pa dang / spangs pa la bya ba yin/ mi 'thad pa'i phyogs ni/ gnas gyur sems tsam pa'i yin zer ba dang / gzhi dus nas stobs sogs rang chas su yod zer ba'o/ /rdo rje theg pa'i yan lag bdun ldan ni ldog pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i snang tshul lo/ /gang la sangs rgyas pa'i rten ni/ mdo lugs 'og min du sangs rgyas par bzhed/ sngags las mi'i rten la tshe gcig gis 'grub pa dang bar do dang skye ba brgyud pa'i dbang du byas nas 'og min la sogs par sangs rgyas par bshad/ dang po ni/ rim gnyis kyi sbyang gzhi ro rkyang sogs kyi rtsa thig 'gro ba gzhan la med par sa'i dngos gzhi sogs su bshad/ bar dor 'grub pa'ang 'chi ba chos sku dang bar do longs skur 'char ba'i gdams ngag la bsgom pa'i nus pa ma thon na/ bar do'i gdams ngag thos bsam gyi yid yul du go ba tsam byas pas ni/ bar do shar ba'i dus su rten de la sangs rgyas thob ga la nus/ brgyud nas 'grub pa'ang de nyid 'dus par 'og tu bshad/ bla med la ma nges te skye ba brgyud nas mi'i rten la 'grub par rdo rje snying 'grel las bshad/ sangs rgyas la ye shes yod med dpyad skabs/ gser 'od dam par/ gnyid sad tshe rmi lam med kyang sems med pa ma yin pa ltar 'khor ba'i rnam rtog zad kyang ye shes med pa ma yin par bshad pa sogs/ dus 'khor dang rim lngar mthar thug gi sangs rgyas ci min gyi stong rkyang min par lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang don dam pa'i bden pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid ro gcig par bshad/

yang 'phags pa thogs med kyi rigs kyi don ni rgyu'i don te/ zhes gsungs/ spyir chos can la spyi bye brag gnyis yod pas/ chos nyid bde gshegs snying po tsam dang / bye brag tu khams bde gshegs snying po gnyis su bshad/ khams bde snying ni chos dbyings la'o/ /'di 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas dang khyad par med par bshad pa dgongs pa can no/ /'bras bu thob zin pa'i dus mi srid pa'i mtha' dpyad pa/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas rung ba yin yang / sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus mi srid de/ lung mang zhing rigs pa nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku ma yin par 'gyur ba sogs 'bras bu mngon du byed tshe nges par nye rgyu dgos shing / 'og min dang bar do'i rten la sangs rgyas pa la yang ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas so/ /yang rnal 'byor pa rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas sprul nas gnang ba'o/ /de gnyis gang rung gis chog go /las rgya dngos dang ye rgya la khyad par yod dam snyam na med do/ /des na spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med de gsum char gyi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa khyad med do// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa gang gtan la dbab par bya ba yan lag gi don la bdun/ rgyud sde so so'i dbye ba/ gtan la dbab bya'i rgyud 'di gang gi phyogs su gtogs dpyad pa/ der gtogs pa'i rgyud 'di rdo rje 'chang gis ji ltar gsung tshul de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi brjod bya'i tshul/ bye brag tu bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag 'phags yul mkhas grub rnams kyi ji ltar bkral tshul/ bod kyi bla ma rnams gang gi rjes su 'brang dpyad pa/ nyams su blang bya'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag rgyud gzhung la brten nas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po'i skabs su/ saṃ ṭi'i/ srin bu'i tshul gyi zhes pa/ srin bu'i shing zos zhing rang nyid 'phel bar byed pa bzhin/ rgod pa la sogs pa 'dod chags kyi kun spyod bzhis lam gyi rtogs pa zos te chos nyid kyi ngo bo gsal bar byed pa ston pa'o/

/rgyud sde bzhi las bla med las thabs shes gnyis med gsum du phye ba 'jog tshul mang yang gtso bor thabs shes kyi gtso bo bskyed rdzogs gnyis nas shas gang che'o/ /pha rgyud la sde gsum dang / ma rgyud la sgo drug tu mkhas pa snga ma rnams bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog bdun 'di bla med de'i nang tshan pha rgyud sde gsum las zhe sdang can 'dul ba gshin rje'i gshed de la dmar nag gnyis las 'dir nag po'o/ /gsum pa ni rtsod bral rtog bdun 'di'i thog mar/ rgyud 'bum phrag gcig pa'am/ gsum pa las mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor ston pa'i le'u gsum pa'i rjes de la bskyed rim dang drag shul gyi las tshogs gtso bor ston pa rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog bdun gsungs/ rtog pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mor/ chos can gzugs can ma yin yang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ don dam par chos thams cad rtog pa med kyang / kun rdzob tu sems can gyi don gyi phyir zhi rgyas dbang drag bsgrub pa'i cho ga dang spros bcas kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa la sogs pa brjod par bstan pas rtog pa zhes brjod/ bdun ni grangs kyi gnad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud sde'i brjod bya smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /bskyed rim skabs thabs shes dbyer med nges don rdo rje 'jigs byed de gzugs sku rdo rje 'jigs byed du bzhed du bzhengs pa ste/ de'ang sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas smon lam de'i khyad bar gyi mthus lha sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dper na klu rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du nam mkha'i dkyil du mdog dang dbyibs tha dad pa'i sprin gyi phung po 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dga' rab dbang phyug gi dbang du ma gyur pa'i bdud sogs ni rigs drug na med la/ de'ang gshin rje'i gshed 'dis 'dul lo/

/kha cig rgyud dang rgya gzhung las rdzogs rim mi gsal zer ba ma go ba'i gtam mo/ /lnga pa la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /lha zhe dgu pa'i bsnyen pa'i skabs su thun gyi mthar gtor ma btang zhing / de'i rjes su dag pa dran pa byas la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug dgos par bshad do/ /bcu bdun ma'i skabs su kha cig srung 'khor la bkod pa'i lha dkyil 'khor la bkod pa mi 'thad zer ba mi 'thad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi gtso 'khor gyi go 'pho ba'i man ngag ni gsang sngags kyi lam srol yin no/ /drug pa ni/ dang por mkhas pa rwa skyo zhang gsum/ tha mar mkhas pa 'gar ldong gnyos gsum te mkhas pa sgo drug go /rwa pa ni grags par zad la/ skyo pa'i srol 'dzin 'dzin pa rin she sogs/ zhang shes rab bla ma/ rdo rje rtse mo/ mar chos 'bar sogs/ 'gar rdo rje snying po/ zom rang chos bzang sogs te zhang pa'i rjes 'brang / ldong shes rab gsal ni rwa pa'i rjes 'brang ngo / /gnyos pa liṃ a tsarya'i rjes 'brang ngo / /snar thang 'jam ral bo dong 'jam ral sogs yum yod sgrub pa sogs mang po zhig ni mi 'thad pa'o/ /dbang gong ma gnyis dang / sta gon gyi skabs su bla ma dang slob ma gnyis kas rang gi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyi sgo nas byed pa yin te/ dper na gsang 'dus pa'i rjes chags kyi skabs su slob ma rin 'byung dang don grub la sogs par 'gyur par bshad pa bzhin no/ /bdun pa la drug ste/ gang gis sgom pa'i gang zag nam bsgom pa'i dus/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i 'dun pa/ gang gis bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ zhar las byung ba 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas las rab 'byams sgrub tshul lo/ /sgom pa'i dus su rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ras bris la sogs pa'i rten rnams bkram/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod rol mo dang bcas pa bsham/

khyad par du gong gi gtor ma'i rgyu rnams las byas pa'i phyogs skyong dang gnas de'i 'byung po rnams la byin rgyu'i gtor ma yang bsham bsam gtan gyi spyod lam byas nas dang por mchod pa rnams byin brlabs te/ gnas khang mchod rdzas rnams la/ de'ang nang mchod yod na rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing / hrīḥṣṭ+rī sogs nas bla ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig zhes brjod la de'i rjes su/ sgrub thabs mdor bstan las/ rdo rje gsum gyis byin rlabs gdab/ /rang ming sa bon ldan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyer mchod lnga so so'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la pra titstsha zhes pa ni 'bul ba'i tshig yin pas skabs 'dir mi brjod/ kha cig sgrub thabs kyi sngon du skyabs 'gro ma bshad zer nas gcod pa nor tshabs che'o/ /ye shes tshogs bsags skabs sems rang gis rang nyid rang bzhin yod med dpyad nas bden med du gtan la 'bebs dgos pa yin no/ /'ga' zhig sems yod med tsam du btsal nas sems ma rnyed pa de nyid sems kyi gnas lugs su ngo sprod pa ni khyad lta sgrub ba'i man ngag khyad par can du gyur par snang ngo / /yul dang yul can dbyer med du bsres nas brjod bral nyams su myong bar byas pa'i ngang nas yod med la sogs pa gang du yang ma 'dzin pa gcig dgos pa yin/ bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ dam tshig nyams pa sogs kyis ma dag par bshad cing rnal 'byor pa tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur/ bskyed rim sems 'dzin mtsho skyes ltar ro/ /dmigs pa gcig la gsal snang gnyis bstan pa ma thob par/ dmigs pa mang po rim can du gcig steng na gcig mthud nas bsgom pa yin la nyon mongs bskyed pa gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'i nyon mongs pa bskyed zhes pa'i don yang dmigs pa mang po gcig steng du gcig brgyud nas bsgom pa las gsal cha dang gnas cha gang yang yong mi srid pas/

de ma byung na rnal 'byor pa tshig pa za ba dang yid mi bde'i sgo nas nyon mongs pa skyed par byed zhes pa'i don no/ /mdor na rtsub shing las me 'don pa ltar dgos pa ni gnad do/ /gtor mar bsad sha 'dre mi rung / thun thams cad kyi rjes sam/ tha na'ang phyi thun gyi rjes so/ /zla re lo re sogs ni/ dus khyad par can la dgongs te/ zla re la dus khyad par can gyi dbang du byas nas nyi shu dgu dang / mang po'i dbang du byas na bcu dgu dang brgyad dang / bcu bzhi dang / bco lnga dang / gnam stong / lo re'i dbang du byas na dpyid zla ra ba'i nyi shu dgu/ gtor mgron ni 'jigs byed dang phyogs skyong la ste/ gnas der gnas pa'i mi ma yin rnams kyang gtor mgron gyi 'byung po'i nang du 'dus gnas bdag de dag la gtor ma sbyin dgos par rdo rje snying 'grel du bshad/ gtor ma lag tu bzung nas sbyong ba dang yang bar mtshams chod pa sogs mi rung / las gang 'grub kyang gtor ma gnad du che/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub gang bsgrub kyang / tha mal gyi chags sdang ni bar chad kyi sgrib pa chen po yin no/ /gzhan 'khrul 'khor sogs ni logs su shes so/ /'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i go don kho bos logs su bris yod do/ /'di yang dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi brjed tho'o/ /mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
